title: backlog.py land leaves the checkout on the landed work branch
goal: backlog.py land returns the checkout to the branch it started on after every run and every stop (git rebase UPSTREAM BRANCH switches to BRANCH), so a later claim --commit does not land on work/<id> and ride into its code/<id> merge request; a TestBacklogLand test asserts git symbolic-ref HEAD after land, content and code lanes and a planted stop

run: import pathlib,re,sys; s=pathlib.Path('_tools/backlog.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); b=s[s.index('def cmd_land'):]; b=b[:b.index(chr(10)+'def ',1)]; sys.exit(0 if re.search(r'"(switch|checkout)"', b) else 1)
